en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 388 - Abu Muhammad Harun Ibn Musa has narrated from Abul Qasim Husain Ibn Abdur Rahim

that Abu Abdur Rahim sent me to Abu Ja’far Muhammad Ibn Uthman Amari for something that was between me and him. I went to him as many of our scholars were present there. They were discussing some traditions from the Imams. At this, Abu Bakr Muhammad Ibn Ahmad Ibn Uthman known as Baghdadi, the nephew of Abu Ja’far Amari came. When Abu Ja’far saw him, he said: “Stop. This man who is coming is not one of you.”
